title: Reported Unlawful Activites In Foreign Lodging House No. 2., Lane 15, Carter Road

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
CONFIDENTIAL
C.S.6, Special Branch.
REPORT
Date October 27th 1938

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 88006
27-10-38

Subject Reported Unlawful Activities In Foreign Lodging House No. 2.
Lane 15, Carter Road.
Made by D.S. Mischenko Forwarded by Inspector E. Payne

I have to report that whilst inspecting house No. 2, Lane
15, Carter Road, Mrs. J. C. E. Hetherington, the licensee of the
house, informed me that she strongly suspects the occupant of
Room No. 15, a Korean named AKEMI HAN, of dealing in narcotics.
According to Mrs. Hetherington, besides numerous telephone
calls, the said Korean, is visited daily by a large number of
Chinese - also suspicious looking characters. Whenever an
occasion arises for Mrs. Hetherington or servants in her employ,
to enter the room occupied by the Korean, there are always some
preparations made in the room, before anyone is allowed to enter.
Mrs. Hetherington went on to say that AKEMI HAN appears to
be quite prosperous at present, though, not long ago, he was in
straitened circumstances.
AKEMI HAN residing with his sister who is a dancing partner
by occupation.

V. Mischenko.
D. S.

FILE
28/10.
A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.)

报告
日期：1938年10月27日

上海公共租界工部局警务处
档案号 B. 登记处
编号 S. B. D. 88006
1938年10月27日

事由：据报卡特路（Carter Road）15弄2号外侨公寓内的非法活动。
报告人：侦探副巡长（D.S.）米申科（Mischenko） 转呈人：督察 E. 佩恩（E. Payne）

兹报告如下：本人在检查卡特路15弄2号时，该公寓持照人 J. C. E. 赫瑟林顿（J. C. E. Hetherington）夫人告知本人，她强烈怀疑居住在15号房间的朝鲜籍住客 AKEMI HAN 从事毒品交易。据赫瑟林顿夫人称，除大量电话往来外，每日均有众多中国人——且多为形迹可疑之徒——拜访该朝鲜人。每当赫瑟林顿夫人或其雇佣的仆役需要进入该朝鲜人居住的房间时，在允许任何人进入之前，房间内总会进行一些准备工作。赫瑟林顿夫人还称，AKEMI HAN 目前似乎相当富裕，尽管不久之前他还处于经济拮据之中。
AKEMI HAN 与其妹同住，其妹职业为舞伴。

V. 米申科（Mischenko）。
侦探副巡长（D. S.）

档案
10月28日。
